item.title: Opinion: As San Diego ages, self-driving cars offer seniors much-needed mobility
item.description: The arrival of Waymo’s autonomous taxis in San Diego is an opportunity to address one of the most persistent barriers facing older adults: transportation.

item.title: California drops suit over federal funds, seeks private investors for bullet train
item.description: Officials said they would focus on other funding sources to complete the project, which is estimated to cost more than $100 billion.

item.title: La Mesa’s top 5 stories in 2025 – a lost officer, school board turmoil and more
item.description: La Mesa experienced some difficult times in 2025, but positives as well, like Grossmont Hospital's 70th anniversary.

item.title: Inside the courthouse where activists are tracking immigration enforcement in real time
item.description: As the mass deportation push has played out in immigration court, the courthouse itself has increasingly become a daily site of opposition.

item.title: Blocked by CSU, community college bachelor’s degrees closer to approval after new analysis
item.description: A new report suggests that the degrees should serve place-bound students who can’t afford to leave their hometown to attend college.

item.title: Mission Times Courier’s top 4 stories of 2025 – tragedy, triumph, growth
item.description: A traffic tragedy and soccer triumphs were some of the biggest stories in Navajo, College Area, San Carlos and more this year.

item.title: Suspect sought after armed robbery at Lincoln Park Subway restaurant
item.description: San Diego police were searching for an armed robbery suspect Saturday in Lincoln Park, where a Subway sandwich shop was held up. Officers were dispatched to the 300 block of Euclid Avenue at about 2 p.m. Saturday after the masked suspect displayed a firearm and fled with money from the cash register, according to the […]

item.title: San Diego County gets a breather before another storm next week
item.description: Patchy clouds hugging the coastal mountain slopes are expected to clear overnight, ushering in a drier stretch Sunday through Tuesday, according to the National Weather Service.

item.title: Helicopter deployed in search for missing 15-year-old last seen in Encinitas
item.description: San Diego County sheriff's deputies were looking Saturday night for a missing 15-year-old boy in Encinitas, broadcasting a bulletin from a helicopter in the area.

item.title: Aztecs’ season ends with narrow New Mexico Bowl loss
item.description: The Aztecs' bid for their 10th 10-win season in program history came up just short as they failed to complete a 22-point second half comeback.
